title: Rate Note on the Base Fee of a Workplace Cafe Management Program Contract
content:
The base fee carried on a contract held under the Workplace Cafe Management Program is set by one reading: when the service model standing on the contract took effect, and what management fee invoicing the contract itself carries over the short window.

#### Setting in force

Where the service model standing on the contract took effect within the billing period being invoiced and the contract carries at least one management fee invoice in the three months up to the day the invoice is raised, the base fee is the mean of the monthly management fee printed against the service model standing on the contract and the management fee most recently invoiced on the contract, rounded to the nearest cent; where the service model standing on the contract took effect within that period and the contract carries no management fee invoice over those three months, the base fee is the management fee most recently invoiced on the contract; and where the service model standing on the contract took effect outside that period, the base fee is the monthly management fee printed against the service model standing on the contract.

#### The settings side by side

| When the service model standing on the contract took effect | Management fee invoices carried on the contract in the 3 months up to the day the invoice is raised | Base fee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Within the billing period being invoiced | At least 1 | The mean of the monthly management fee printed against the service model standing on the contract and the management fee most recently invoiced on the contract, rounded to the nearest cent |
| Within the billing period being invoiced | None over those 3 months | The management fee most recently invoiced on the contract |
| Outside the billing period being invoiced | Not in question | The monthly management fee printed against the service model standing on the contract |

#### Notes the committee records

The window counted is the 3 months up to the day the invoice is raised, and what is counted in it is management fee invoicing standing on the contract's own ledger. The effective day of the service model standing on the contract is read against the billing period being invoiced, not against any other month. The mean is struck on the two figures named and rounded to the nearest cent once, as it is struck.

#### A setting worked on hypothetical figures

On hypothetical figures, take a contract whose service model standing on it took effect within the billing period being invoiced, carrying 2 management fee invoices in the 3 months up to the day the invoice is raised. The monthly management fee printed against that service model is taken, hypothetically, as 5125.00 USD and the management fee most recently invoiced on the contract as 3990.01 USD. The mean of those two hypothetical figures is 4557.505 USD before rounding, so the base fee is 4557.51 USD.

Had the same contract carried no management fee invoice over those 3 months, the base fee on the same hypothetical figures would be 3990.01 USD, the management fee most recently invoiced on the contract. Had the service model standing on it taken effect outside the billing period being invoiced, the base fee would be the monthly management fee printed against the service model standing on the contract, hypothetically 5125.00 USD.
